note: Both sets contain the same seven claims with identical values, bindings, and quotes; the only difference is that B adds 'conditions: Region 3' to the rated generator speed claim. That condition is supported by the surrounding sentence (the PI control in Region 3 uses the rated generator speed), though rated speed is itself a general generator property, so the addition is neutral rather than an error. Neither set misreads, misbinds, or invents anything, and both capture the key torque saturation, rate limit, damping, and control-structure facts.
